dialogues.jp: ベッドに寝かせた音夢が、苦しげな息を漏らす。
dialogues.en: Nemu was breathing heavily as she lay on the bed.
dialogues.text: Nemu was breathing heavily as she lay on the bed.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱ、ちょっと熱があるな」
dialogues.en: "She has a fever."
dialogues.text: "She has a fever."

dialogues.jp:
それほどではないが、額に当てた手から伝わる
体温が心なしか熱い。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't that bad, but I could feel that her temperature
was slightly higher than usual.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't that bad, but I could feel that her temperature
was slightly higher than usual.

dialogues.jp:
手馴れてしまった感もあるが、たらいに汲んで
きた水にタオルを浸して音夢の額にのせる。
dialogues.en:
I'm so used to this by now, but I brought a bucket full of
water and soaked the towel to put it onto her forehead.
dialogues.text:
I'm so used to this by now, but I brought a bucket full of
water and soaked the towel to put it onto her forehead.

dialogues.jp: 手持ち｛ぶさた／無沙汰｝にベッドの脇に座る。
dialogues.en: I sat by the bed, with nothing to do.
dialogues.text: I sat by the bed, with nothing to do.

dialogues.jp:
「なんか、こうやって看病するのも久しぶりだ
　よな音夢」
dialogues.en: "It's been a while since I last did this."
dialogues.text: "It's been a while since I last did this."

dialogues.jp:
答えはないけれど、その無防備な寝顔を見てい
るだけで胸が痛い。
dialogues.en:
She didn't answer me, but I felt bad looking at her innocent
face as she slept.
dialogues.text:
She didn't answer me, but I felt bad looking at her innocent
face as she slept.

dialogues.jp:
いつもは頑張り屋の妹に対する心配なのだが
……。
dialogues.en:
I usually worry because she's my sister who tries too hard.
But now I didn't want her to be hurt, as her boyfriend.
dialogues.text:
I usually worry because she's my sister who tries too hard.
But now I didn't want her to be hurt, as her boyfriend.

dialogues.jp:
今は恋人としてのこいつに傷ついて欲しくなかっ
た。
dialogues.en: "I'm sure you know this by now, but don't try too hard."
dialogues.text: "I'm sure you know this by now, but don't try too hard."

dialogues.jp:
「もう耳タコだろうけどさ、頑張りすぎなんだ
　よお前」
dialogues.en: I pushed her cheek.
dialogues.text: I pushed her cheek.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「う……ううん……兄さん……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp: つついていた指を、そのまま音夢に握られる。
dialogues.en: Nemu grabbed my finger as I was pushing her cheek.
dialogues.text: Nemu grabbed my finger as I was pushing her cheek.

dialogues.jp: 「ははは……」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha..."

dialogues.jp: 「なんだろうな。嬉しいような寂しいような」
dialogues.en: "What's this? I feel kind of happy but sad."
dialogues.text: "What's this? I feel kind of happy but sad."

dialogues.jp: 「こんな時だけ甘えたり弱かったりしてさ……」
dialogues.en:
"You only depend on me and show any weakness when you're
sick."
dialogues.text:
"You only depend on me and show any weakness when you're
sick."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんか……。あんまりいつもと変わらなくて
　さ……」
dialogues.en: "Everything else is still the same......"
dialogues.text: "Everything else is still the same......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃ……けどさ」
dialogues.en: "It's a pain...... But..."
dialogues.text: "It's a pain...... But..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「けどさ……」
なんとなく恥ずかしくて黙る。
dialogues.en: I shut up because I felt embarrassed.
dialogues.text: I shut up because I felt embarrassed.

dialogues.jp:
こんな、相手が聞いてないときに独り言みたい
に言うのはずるい気がした。
dialogues.en: I felt it wasn't fair to say this when she wasn't listening.
dialogues.text: I felt it wasn't fair to say this when she wasn't listening.

dialogues.jp: ぼーっと天井を見上げる。
dialogues.en: I looked up the ceiling.
dialogues.text: I looked up the ceiling.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "But?"
dialogues.text: "But?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「けどさ……なに？」
dialogues.en: "But...... What?"
dialogues.text: "But...... What?"

dialogues.jp: 片目だけ開けて、音夢が俺を見上げていた。
dialogues.en: Nemu was looking at me with one eye opened.
dialogues.text: Nemu was looking at me with one eye opened.

dialogues.jp: 「いつから起きてた？」
dialogues.en: "When did you wake up?"
dialogues.text: "When did you wake up?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「頬をつつかれた時にね」
dialogues.en: "When you pushed my cheek."
dialogues.text: "When you pushed my cheek."

dialogues.jp:
のっそりと上半身を起こして音夢が苦笑いを浮
かべる。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled as she got up slowly.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled as she got up slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「けどさ、けどさ、けどさなに？」
dialogues.en: "So, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "So, what is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん♪」
dialogues.en: "Niisan."
dialogues.text: "Niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……聞きたいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to hear it?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to hear it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「熱があがっても知らないぞ」
dialogues.en: "Your fever might get worse."
dialogues.text: "Your fever might get worse."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いいんだよ。私は体温が低いから、兄さんか
　ら熱をもらうくらいで丁度いいの」
dialogues.en:
"It's fine. I normally have a low temperature anyway, it
would make me normal."
dialogues.text:
"It's fine. I normally have a low temperature anyway, it
would make me normal."

dialogues.jp: 俺の手を抱きしめて、音夢がニコリと笑う。
dialogues.en: She held my hand and smiled softly.
dialogues.text: She held my hand and smiled softly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんもね、無理しなくていいんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You don't have to try too hard either."
dialogues.text: "You don't have to try too hard either."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私の体が弱いのは兄さんのせいじゃないし、
　そんなに気張らなくてもいいんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"It's not your fault that I get sick a lot, and you don't
have to try so hard."
dialogues.text:
"It's not your fault that I get sick a lot, and you don't
have to try so hard."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんか、がんばっちゃってるの、兄さんらし
　くないでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "It's not like you if you try too hard, don't you think?"
dialogues.text: "It's not like you if you try too hard, don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんか、さりげなく滅茶苦茶なこと言われて
　ないか俺？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't that kind of a mean thing to say?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't that kind of a mean thing to say?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「言ってないよ」
dialogues.en: "No way."
dialogues.text: "No way."

dialogues.jp: 小さく頷いて、音夢が夢見ごこちに目を閉じる。
dialogues.en: She closed her eyes looking very content.
dialogues.text: She closed her eyes looking very content.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私ね、なんとなく兄さんのこと分かるの……
　私のことどんなに心配してくれてるか」
dialogues.en: "I think I know why you worry so much about me..."
dialogues.text: "I think I know why you worry so much about me..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どんなに好きだとか、授業中とかもさ、さり
　げなく気にしてくれるのが分かるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"How much you love me. I even know that you care about me
during the class."
dialogues.text:
"How much you love me. I even know that you care about me
during the class."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「背中に目がついてるのかお前は」
dialogues.en: "You have eyes on your back?"
dialogues.text: "You have eyes on your back?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だから……それじゃあロマンがないでしょ？
　心が繋がってるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "No, that's scary...... My heart's connected to yours."
dialogues.text: "No, that's scary...... My heart's connected to yours."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お前、本当に恥ずかしいこと臆面もなく言う
　奴だな……」
dialogues.en: "How can you say such an embarrassing thing like that?"
dialogues.text: "How can you say such an embarrassing thing like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いいでしょうが……で、誤魔化しちゃダメだ
　よ。けどさなんなの？」
dialogues.en:
"It isn't a bad thing. Don't beat around the bush. So, what
is it?"
dialogues.text:
"It isn't a bad thing. Don't beat around the bush. So, what
is it?"

dialogues.jp:
ため息をついて、あんなこと呟かなければと、
ちと後悔する。
dialogues.en:
I sighed and regretted that I even mumbled something like
that.
dialogues.text:
I sighed and regretted that I even mumbled something like
that.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ドキドキしてるよね、今」
dialogues.en: "Your heart's pounding really fast now."
dialogues.text: "Your heart's pounding really fast now."

dialogues.jp:
今から言うことを考えたら、ドキドキくらい、
する。
dialogues.en: "Of course......"
dialogues.text: "Of course......"

dialogues.jp:
「あのさ……俺、本当に本気でお前のこと好き
　だ」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I think I really love you."
dialogues.text: "Well...... I think I really love you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でさ」
dialogues.en: "And."
dialogues.text: "And."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ちょっと待ってちょっと待って！」
dialogues.en: "Wait, hold on."
dialogues.text: "Wait, hold on."

dialogues.jp: 胸をおさえて音夢が俺を上目遣いに見上げる。
dialogues.en: Nemu pressed her chest and looked at me.
dialogues.text: Nemu pressed her chest and looked at me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「な、なんで突然そんなこと……は、恥ずかし
　い」
dialogues.en: "Why now? You're embarrassing me."
dialogues.text: "Why now? You're embarrassing me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「自分でふったんだから聞けよ」
dialogues.en: "You asked me, so listen."
dialogues.text: "You asked me, so listen."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだけどさぁ……あぁ、びっくりした」
dialogues.en: "You're right...... but you scared me."
dialogues.text: "You're right...... but you scared me."

dialogues.jp: 深呼吸して音夢が小さく肩を落とす。
dialogues.en: Nemu dropped her shoulders after exhaling.
dialogues.text: Nemu dropped her shoulders after exhaling.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「本当におかしいよ兄さん。熱でもあるんじゃ
　ないの？」
dialogues.en: "You're acting weird today. Don't you have a fever?"
dialogues.text: "You're acting weird today. Don't you have a fever?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「熱があるのはお前だ」
dialogues.en: "You're the one who has a fever."
dialogues.text: "You're the one who has a fever."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それは……そうだけど」
dialogues.en: "And so, don't get mad and listen 'til the end."
dialogues.text: "And so, don't get mad and listen 'til the end."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……いいか。怒るなよ？　最後まで聞け」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Is this a confession of love? It's so romantic."
dialogues.text: "Okay. Is this a confession of love? It's so romantic."

dialogues.jp: 音夢がわざわざ俺の状態を口にする。
dialogues.en: Nemu described what I was trying to do.
dialogues.text: Nemu described what I was trying to do.

dialogues.jp: 新手のイジメかこれは……。
dialogues.en: Is she picking on me?
dialogues.text: Is she picking on me?

dialogues.jp:
「あー、でだ。今までの俺達はちょっと“ごっ
　こ”だった気がするんだ」
dialogues.en:
"And so, I think what we were doing until now was
'playing'."
dialogues.text:
"And so, I think what we were doing until now was
'playing'."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ごっこ？」
dialogues.en: "A play?"
dialogues.text: "A play?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「恋人ごっこ――って言うのか。なんか兄妹の
　延長にぶらさがってた感じでさ」
dialogues.en:
"It's like playing boyfriend and girlfriend and still being
a brother and a sister."
dialogues.text:
"It's like playing boyfriend and girlfriend and still being
a brother and a sister."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「つまりさ。このまま、なにもなくいつも通り
　に戻っても大丈夫だったと言うのか……」
dialogues.en: "I mean, it was still okay if we went back to normal."
dialogues.text: "I mean, it was still okay if we went back to normal."

dialogues.jp:
しょせん独り言だったので、いまいち上手くま
とまらない。
dialogues.en:
I can't describe the point as I wanted to since I was
talking to myself.
dialogues.text:
I can't describe the point as I wanted to since I was
talking to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……やっぱり迷惑だった？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan...... was I annoying you?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan...... was I annoying you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから、先に最後まで聞けと言うたろうが！」
dialogues.en: "I told you to listen 'til the end!"
dialogues.text: "I told you to listen 'til the end!"

dialogues.jp: ゆるんだ音夢の手を、俺から強く握り返す。
dialogues.en: I grabbed her hand tightly as she tries to let go.
dialogues.text: I grabbed her hand tightly as she tries to let go.

dialogues.jp:
「だから！　俺はお前のこと妹としてじゃなく
　て、本気で恋人として好きになると言ってる
　んだ！」
dialogues.en:
"So what I'm saying is that I love you as my girlfriend and
not as my sister!"
dialogues.text:
"So what I'm saying is that I love you as my girlfriend and
not as my sister!"

dialogues.jp: 頭に血が上った勢いで、そのまま叫ぶ。
dialogues.en: I shouted out as I became more excited.
dialogues.text: I shouted out as I became more excited.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「な、な、なんでそういうことを怒りながら言
　うのよ！」
dialogues.en: "Why did you say that as if you were upset?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you say that as if you were upset?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が目をふせて頭を振る。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked down and shook her head.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked down and shook her head.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ……もったいない……もう、この兄さん
　たら全然分かってないんだから……」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god...... You just don't get it, do you?"
dialogues.text: "Oh my god...... You just don't get it, do you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ダメ……兄さん、今のシーンやりなおすから
　部屋から一度出てって」
dialogues.en:
"No, niisan. We have to do this scene over again. Get out of
the room."
dialogues.text:
"No, niisan. We have to do this scene over again. Get out of
the room."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「よし……やり直そう」
dialogues.en: "Fine...... We'll do this over again."
dialogues.text: "Fine...... We'll do this over again."

dialogues.jp: 立ち上がって呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled as I stood up.
dialogues.text: I mumbled as I stood up.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今のはなかったことにする」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing happened just now...... So, it's your turn to make
a confession of love."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing happened just now...... So, it's your turn to make
a confession of love."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今度はお前から俺に告白するんだ」
部屋の扉に手をかけて、振り返る。
dialogues.en: I reached out to the door knob and turned around.
dialogues.text: I reached out to the door knob and turned around.

dialogues.jp: 「お前が誤魔化すなよ音夢」
dialogues.en: "Don't try to beat around the bush, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Don't try to beat around the bush, Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おやすみ」
dialogues.en: "Good night."
dialogues.text: "Good night."

dialogues.jp: 少しの間だけ、音夢の返答を待って――。
dialogues.en: I waited for a moment to wait for her reply......
dialogues.text: I waited for a moment to wait for her reply......

dialogues.jp: 扉を閉めた。
dialogues.en: I closed the door.
dialogues.text: I closed the door.

dialogues.jp: ◆恋人ごっこ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Pretending to be lovers◆
dialogues.text: ◆Pretending to be lovers◆

dialogues.jp: 音夢が倒れたことで、その大切さに気づいた俺。
dialogues.en: I realized how important Nemu was to me when she collapsed.
dialogues.text: I realized how important Nemu was to me when she collapsed.

dialogues.jp:
キスをしたり抱きしめ合ったりしていても、ま
だ本物の恋人にはなってないと思った。
dialogues.en:
I felt like we weren't a real couple even though we were
kissing.
dialogues.text:
I felt like we weren't a real couple even though we were
kissing.

dialogues.jp:
俺は音夢が好きだと告白しなおし、音夢からの
返事を待つことにした。
dialogues.en:
I told her that I really love her and decided to wait for
her reply.
dialogues.text:
I told her that I really love her and decided to wait for
her reply.
